contexts.text: Thou shalt make them linen breeches () = the external of [marriage] love... because they covered the loins... The reason the breeches were of linen, was that linen = external or natural truth; and the very external itself is truth. AC 9960. AC 9961. AC 9962.
Hence the breeches which were upon Aaron and his sons were for a protection from the Hells. Explained.
The courtiers wore... breeches and stockings of opaline silk.
